mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NAME, M.POINT, G.GRADE_NAME, G.DISCOUNT_RATE, DA.ADDRESS_NAME, DA.DETAIL_ADDRESS FROM MEMBER M JOIN GRADE G ON M.GRADE_ID = G.GRADE_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERYADDRESS DA ON M.MEMBER_ID = DA.MEMBER_ID AND UPPER(DA.IS_DEFAULT) = 'Y' WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT C.POP_ID, C.QTY, PO.OPTION_NAME, PO.OPTION_PRICE, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM CART C JOIN OPTIONDETAIL POP ON C.POP_ID = POP.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCTOPTION PO ON POP.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON POP.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE C.CART_ID IN
#{item}

SELECT POP.POP_ID, PO.OPTION_NAME, PO.OPTION_PRICE, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM OPTIONDETAIL POP JOIN PRODUCTOPTION PO ON POP.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON POP.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE POP.POP_ID = #{popId}
